one_liner: Believes the caretaker exemption covers a 15-year-old, has stopped reporting entirely, six days left — human help now

notice.title: Action needed: report your qualifying hours

situation: 47-year-old caring for a 15-year-old, convinced the caretaker exemption applies (it generally covers children 13 and younger) and has therefore reported nothing — no hours, no documents. Six days remain on the notice, and the facts and the belief point in different directions.
